description: TYOL (ToyotaLight) BOP test set - 21 scenes, 21 object classes

preprocessing.description: Square resize with padding to maintain aspect ratio. Depth scale 1000 converts mm to m.

camera.description: Per-frame camera intrinsics loaded from scene_camera.json (BOP format). Intrinsics vary per frame (fx ~530-545, fy ~535-550, cx ~305-325, cy ~230-245).

mesh_scale_description: BOP meshes are in millimeters, convert to meters for pose evaluation

objects.description: 21 everyday objects captured in tabletop scenarios

format.description: BOP19 format with visible masks and GT poses in JSON

notes: Depth maps are in PNG format with 1mm scale (uint16, millimeters)
GT poses in scene_gt.json: cam_R_m2c (flattened 3x3), cam_t_m2c (mm units)
Masks are instance-level BOP format: mask_visib/{frame:06d}_{instance:06d}.png
Object names and descriptions in Oryon metadata (models_name.json)
